apple-tv-user-sign-in.answer: Select each Apple TV user, authorize the desired Plozz profile, then enable Settings > Profiles > Automatically Sign In. The shared roster and server sign-ins do not make active selection or the trusted startup session shared: those remain system-user-local and opt-in. Manual switches and changed trust still require authorization; this is not a name match or server-user creation.

combined-library-browsing.answer: Apple TV All Libraries pages enabled non-music libraries across accounts in one grid, with identity-based merging where possible and original-server ownership preserved. Enable its navigation shortcut when multiple browsable libraries exist; horizontal tabs do not enable it by default. Choose a copy through the title's server/version selector. The current mobile app has no matching All Libraries destination.

continue-watching-retention.answer: Home defaults to an unbounded provider feed with no next-episode age cutoff. Recency sorts rather than expires titles. This does not override what providers return, watched/removal state, library visibility or account access. Merge Next Up rows defaults on in Customize Home > Continue Watching, folding source-supplied next episodes into Continue Watching while hiding separate editor rows. Disable it to arrange those rows separately; removing Continue Watching suspends merging.

alphabet-navigation.answer: In an Apple TV name-sorted title browse, scroll a few rows down to reveal the indexed letter rail and focus a letter to jump. Collection members and other sorts do not qualify. Combined or Silo jumps load on demand; select the letter again after a failed jump, or change sort away and back to name to rebuild a failed index. Mobile has feedback/destination hooks but no constructed alphabet menu or rail entry point.

top-shelf.answer: Put Plozz in Apple TV's top Home Screen row. From an adult profile, Settings > Everyone > Top Shelf offers default-on Show Top Shelf, Posters (default) or Full Screen and independent 1-20 Continue Watching/Recently Added counts, defaulting to four each. Full Screen expands with tvOS swipe-up; Play requests playback while More Info opens details without autoplay. Poster selection requests playback. Preferences stay device-local across Plozz profiles; disabling clears media but retains choices. A saved, access-scoped Home snapshot is not live browsing; short feeds are not padded, same-source repeats deduplicate in Full Screen, and authorization/source failures remain visible. Artwork and full-screen spoilers respect profile policy.

community-skip-markers.answer: Settings > Playback > Skip intros, credits & more controls marker actions; Use community markers defaults on and fills missing server markers through IntroDB/TheIntroDB. Requests send movie/series IMDb, TMDB or TVDB IDs plus applicable episode coordinates, ordering, episode name and runtime, not video files. Matching and database availability limit coverage. Turning this off stops community requests, not server-provided markers.

dual-subtitles.answer: Select a primary text subtitle, then a different text track through Apple TV Style > Dual Subtitles (or the direct Dual Subtitles control) or mobile Second Track; its Off removes only the second line. Plozzigen can decode embedded second text tracks, while the native sidecar path requires a fetchable delivery source. Image primaries disable dual mode and images are never eligible second tracks. Locally remuxed wireless AirPlay has no selectable subtitles.

library-channels.answer: Open Live TV Sources > Plozz channels; enable the automatic lineup or Create custom channel. Choose accessible Plex/Jellyfin/Emby libraries, movies/episodes, order and rules, then Preview schedule and Save channel. Missing/invalid durations exclude titles; blank rules allow all matches. Changes start after published programs. Cross-device schedules need catalogue snapshots. Update watch history can mark 90%-viewed programs watched without resume writes; playback uses original files, not IPTV or Silo sources.

offline-background.answer: On iPhone/iPad, start an eligible movie/episode download, or open a show's Manage Seasons to download all available episodes or choose a season/episode. Choose quality, wait for completed status in Downloads and test that version's video, audio and subtitles offline. Eligible HTTP transfers use background sessions; in-process/share transfers need foreground execution unless the OS grants continued processing. iOS/iPadOS 26 Live Activities can be declined; cancellation/expiry pauses active work without deleting partial files. All received bytes still require offline validation. Network, speed, source and storage limits remain; Apple TV has no downloads.

cross-server-history.answer: Sync across all my servers in Trackers (mobile also exposes Sync watch state across servers in Playback) defaults on and propagates watched-state/resume updates to matching accessible copies. Apple TV enables its control when multiple servers exist. Turning it off keeps writes scoped to the originating server. This is distinct from CloudKit configuration/profile sync and from scrobbling to third-party trackers; server identities and permissions still govern delivery.

version-selection.answer: Use the first-use Ask every time or Choose automatically choice and the title/player version controls where supported. Series-version memory is independent of prompt mode. Automatic mode can use a device recommendation when the remembered type is missing; it does not promise that every episode has the same file.

device-setup.answer: Choose Set up from another device on the receiver and send from the configured device's iCloud Sync screen over the same local network, allowing Local Network access. Use nearby selection, code or QR; camera permission is needed for scanning. Compare codes when prompted; same-account rendezvous can authenticate without that comparison. Only supported credentials transfer. Mobile iCloud Keychain can separately adopt supported server/share/Seerr logins; Apple TV uses pairing or sign-in instead and Silo always needs its own device approval.

App/PlozziOS/Info.plist.summary: Local Network permission supports discovery/pairing; Camera is used for setup QR scanning with code entry as an alternative. Background audio, processing and download task identifiers support documented route- and OS-dependent behavior, not guaranteed execution. External-app query schemes support Infuse/VLC availability; the registered return URL is routed by the mobile root through validated external playback receipts into authorized viewer-owned watch mutations, not accepted as arbitrary progress.

App/PlozziOS/PlozziOS.branded.entitlemen.omitReason: Side-by-side development builds intentionally omit canonical cloud and associated-domain capabilities; these internal provisioning variants are not consumer setup features.

App/PlozziOS/PlozziOS.entitlements.summary: CloudKit/presence and pairing universal links are wired; supported mobile credentials use a separate synchronizable Keychain path rather than making all CloudKit server descriptors authenticated.

App/Resources/Info.plist.summary: The declared Guide-button activity is consumed by MainTabView only when Live TV is enabled, then opens the full-screen channel player's guide. Background audio uses the music controller and Now Playing session for screensaver listening and Control Center commands. External-app query schemes detect Native Player/Infuse/VLC; RootView routes the registered callback into nonce-, URL-, age- and authorization-validated receipts before AppState writes viewer-owned progress. External handoff is separate from AirPlay and Apple's in-app native engine.

App/Resources/Plozz.branded.entitlements.omitReason: Empty entitlements belong to internal side-by-side development builds; production Apple TV user management and Top Shelf use the canonical entitlements instead.

TopShelf/ContentProvider.swift.summary: The extension renders the shared saved snapshot as native poster sections or a details carousel. Full Screen has distinct Play/More Info routes; both resolve only within admitted active accounts. The adult settings entry controls default-on visibility, style and per-feed counts on this device without broadening source permissions.

TopShelf/TopShelf.branded.entitlements.omitReason: This development-only Top Shelf extension deliberately lacks the canonical app group; it does not add a user-facing control or alternative setup procedure.

connections.summary: Connect supported media servers, approved Silo devices, IPTV accounts, or wired share transports; distinguish shared sign-ins from profile library selection. Compare Silo approval codes. Manage verified local/remote addresses per sign-in and device, with trust, HTTP and Silo approval limits, then confirm actual access. Tailscale needs a connection on the playback device and manual server IP/MagicDNS entry, not LAN discovery.

library.summary: Browse, filter, sort, search and combine enabled video libraries on Apple TV; distinguish the wired name-sort letter rail and reachable failure recovery from unused shared alphabet-menu code and mobile feedback hooks. Find collections, extras and IPTV on-demand libraries, choose a server/version copy, manage profile Watchlists including WeTrakr planning-list changes, and update watched state. Remove from Continue Watching uses provider dismissal while retaining position when possible, otherwise clears resume without marking watched; cross-server history policy controls matching copies. Explain incomplete collections and recovery. Distinguish request results from playable copies, presentation from access, and upcoming dates/unaired placeholders from playable ownership or automatic acquisition.

home-navigation.summary: Use the shared Customize Home section editor: Add section, Remove section, Reorder/Done, pinned Apple TV Home layout/mobile Hero entry, presets with replacement confirmation, source-load Retry and default-on Next Up merging. Presets never edit the server. Editing saves a custom arrangement rather than following server order. Library availability is separate; removing a Home section never disables browsing. Explain Apple TV Showcase versus Fullscreen Hero, Hero content sources > Discovery > Discovery providers catalogue selection, navigation hold-to-hide/show/move and mobile drag reordering, then detail presentation; link independent Continue Watching artwork, playback details and labels. Public Discovery browsing does not require Seerr, but requesting unowned titles does; Kids profiles cannot use Discovery.

appearance.summary: Group themes, card density, labels, focus emphasis and watched indicators. Explain label presets replacing per-view overrides, Home/Recommended Mixed hiding captions in Showcase or on series artwork, and Continue Watching's separate Follow Appearance/On/Off control in Customize Home. Distinguish cover labels from Browse labels on collection/playlist members. Retain solid versus system-controlled Liquid Glass, artwork scopes and saved download images, System language, and interface/media/server-language and device-region boundaries. System-drawn player controls and permission prompts retain the device language rather than the profile's override.

spoilers.summary: Identify platform-specific spoiler-toggle labels, blur versus placeholder, in-progress image/text treatment, and independent hidden ratings and reveal. Continue Watching offers Artwork + logo, Thumbnail and Poster: only Thumbnail uses episode stills and their masking. Playback details independently selects Detailed or Progress only; Labels independently follows Appearance or forces On/Off. Neither changes history or row membership. Restore an absent Continue Watching section through Add section before configuring its cards.

circadian.summary: Set solar-region, manual or always-on dimming, adjust warmth and fade, preview a day, disable the effect, and separate profile-owned app tint from system or TV settings.

playback.summary: Use controls and same-account versions, first-use Ask every time/Choose automatically and independent series memory; automatic mode can fall back to recommendations while ask mode also applies to autoplay. Retain autoplay/community-marker defaults, Up Next, skips, resume rewind, speed, zoom and no chapter picker. Cast page navigation ends playback and credits need not be playable. The focused external-player task covers Advanced settings, device-wide choice, platform-specific installed apps, direct Plex/Jellyfin/Emby video only, conversion/offline/source fallback, trusted token-bearing links, SRT-only handoff, no Plozz controls, custom templates, and authorized 24-hour progress returns. Native Player/Infuse support resume/returns; VLC/custom do not.

quality.summary: Set profile-owned mobile defaults or apply a one-session Quality limit, identify Maximum as original quality, and distinguish limits from forced conversion. Current stream reports active rendition facts during conversion, never substituted limit values; Not available is not codec/resolution evidence. Retain provider/platform and Silo limits, fitting-original behavior, and device-wide unsynced Video buffer. External handoff stays in Plozz when mobile quality policy is below Maximum or forces conversion, even when an individual original might fit the limit. Advanced > Dolby Vision FEL (experimental) is separately profile-owned, default-off and applied to eligible new built-in on-demand sessions on TV/mobile. Explain seekable Profile 7/file/hardware limits, GPU/memory/stutter costs, and disabling/restarting to compare without claiming a successful display output from the toggle alone.

audio.summary: Select tracks and language policy, explain remembered series choices and lack of adjustable audio delay in wired engines, and enable opt-in mobile Background Audio with network-use consequences. In video/Live TV Audio, tvOS-supported Reduce Loud Sounds and Enhance Dialogue change system-wide settings, not profiles. Explain Enhance More/Enhance/Off versus binary-only output support, route/content-dependent effect and Apple TV Settings recovery for a failed change. Do not confuse this system bridge with unused engine-local Dialog Enhance capabilities.

subtitles.summary: Select/search tracks, distinguish forced/SDH and per-content policies, enter mobile language codes or follow device language, style text or Live TV, and manage second tracks. Prefer SDH permits regular fallback; Only SDH keeps automatic selection and search/download strict when no SDH is available, without overriding manual or remembered choices. Matching device caption style replaces custom appearance after confirmation; custom edits exit matching while placement/dual controls remain Plozz-specific. Explain embedded Plozzigen versus fetchable native text, image-primary exclusion, secondary Off, timing and AirPlay limits. External apps receive only eligible fetchable SRT sidecars, not Plozz styling/dual-subtitle guarantees; custom templates receive no subtitle links.

music.summary: Find Apple TV music from supported server libraries, start album/playlist sessions, use shuffle/repeat and mini-player controls, continue listening through the screensaver and use Control Center Now Playing transport controls. Trace the background-audio declaration through the controller and shared system-command session. Explain synchronized lyrics availability and Last.fm eligibility without promising mobile music or downloads.

live-tv.summary: Set up IPTV or server channels and distinguish direct M3U catalogues from web pages, single-stream HLS and XMLTV. The main sign-in form exposes EPG URL (optional); Advanced options adds guides, playlist authentication and separate playlist/stream versus guide headers. Guide headers are scoped to the first guide URL's server, with empty fields following playlist credentials. Prefer HTTPS. Explain device-local account file imports separately from encrypted source-copy sync. Find on-demand libraries, correct guide mappings, favorite/hide channels and run per-playlist reachability checks. Review channel identities restores a saved channel only after same-station/feed confirmation; favorites, hidden state and guide corrections follow that identity, otherwise the separate entry remains playable. Channels/Programs search tunes live, not from programme start. Kids playlist-source PIN approvals grant the whole source locally, not ratings-based filtering or server-account authorization. Retain four-pane/provider Multiview limits, previews/cellular policy and original-file library-channel schedule/history limits.

offline.summary: Download and test a validated, completed mobile copy offline. Use Manage Seasons for all available episodes or a season/episode selection; unavailable catalogue placeholders cannot download. Distinguish background HTTP from in-process/share execution and fallible iOS 26 continued processing; receiving every byte is not completed offline validation. Retain quality/network policy, provider preparation, all-audio/subtitle limits, speed caps and uncapped background behavior. Reduced Jellyfin/Emby copies require Download Speed > Limit > Unlimited, despite the error message calling this Full Speed. Explain storage and notification permission; Cancel Active Downloads deletes unfinished copies but preserves completed ones, while Delete All Downloads removes this profile's saved movies and episodes. Pausing preserves work for resumption; server originals are not removed.

profiles.summary: Separate app profiles/server users/Apple TV system users, mobile editing/switching, profile locks/Plex PIN reuse and automatic startup trust. A household PIN enforces Kids settings/switching and Seerr admin-request gates. Kids playlist sources separately require a valid parental PIN approval: whole-source, local-only, and tied to source/profile identity, not ratings filtering. No forgotten-PIN reset control is wired: the unused ProfileLockCopy strings are not a recovery workflow. Removing a lock on another device requires already-unlocked editing access and sync to propagate. Preserve shared household versus system-user-local distinctions.

sync.summary: Distinguish CloudKit configuration, encrypted tracker tokens, mobile Keychain adoption, provider-limited nearby transfer and Silo approval. Explain network/permission/code-verification requirements, separate cross-server history, and local downloads/startup/buffer/Top Shelf preferences. External-player selection is device-wide, not profile-owned or transferable; returned progress remains scoped to the original authorized viewer/server identity. Live TV source copies sync encrypted per profile; account-imported M3U files and Kids approvals stay local, schedules need snapshots, and legacy source-copy import is not the current account importer. In iCloud Sync > Troubleshooting, Refresh Breakdown updates encoded local payload/count snapshots, not iCloud storage: include pending uploads/catalogue schedules, exclude pending deletions/downloaded IPTV guides and separately stored Keychain/Trakt sign-in records. Cover reload/reset/erase, re-upload prevention and mobile-only erasure of Keychain logins.

tracking.summary: Connect profile-owned video/anime/music trackers and check media/account/build eligibility. Distinguish outbound playback-to-history scrobbling from readable/writable Watchlists: Plozz does not import a tracker's complete watch history into media servers. Supported external returns can deliver unfinished Trakt pause progress through the durable watch outbox; finished returns keep normal history reporting. Mark as Unwatched does not delete Trakt history. WeTrakr is enabled by the production flag but still requires configured client credentials; its settings, both playback fan-outs and planning-list destination are wired. Document its authorization, Watchlist behavior, Retry/profile-wide Reconnect and failed-revocation recovery without promising the row in an unconfigured build.

requests.summary: Configure the shared authorized Seerr connection and per-profile acting user, request eligible titles/seasons, distinguish standard requests from offline downloads or 4K requests, and explain quotas and relinking. Trace Kids/admin enforcement through both shells and ProfileStore: unrestricted admin requests are blocked only with a household Parental PIN; advise a restricted Seerr user as well.

metadata.summary: Explain shared provider priorities/disablement, device-local TMDB credential verification, per-profile artwork choices, source/build-dependent ratings and informational ages. Movie/TV shares can use matching video-stem NFO files, show-root tvshow.nfo and recognized local poster/fanart files; rescan and metadata work are required, malformed/ambiguous associations are not guaranteed, and artwork preferences still apply. Explain Plex movie/show family-guidance tiles and viewing-account Plex Pass requirements for detailed guidance. Scope cache budgets/clearing to lookup data and derived artwork, not downloaded video storage or matching repair.

help.summary: Offer symptom entry points, non-destructive checks, reset/cache scope and incomplete library/Continue Watching Details/Try Again recovery. No streams found on details is an explicit source-inventory result: select it to recheck without starting playback, or choose another accessible copy; do not infer it from a timeout. Explain Discord versus tracked GitHub reports, mobile email, duplicates, reproduction/device/source details and safe sharing. Uploading diagnostics does not file an issue. Local Error Details/Share details need no crash consent; distinguish endpoint/consent-dependent uploads and Playback Info's engine/delivery/stream telemetry. External-player fallback and return-progress sections explain unsupported sources, quality policy, invalid/expired returns and automatic retry in the original authorized context rather than resetting progress or credentials.

platforms.summary: Explain remote/touch/keyboard differences, VoiceOver suppression, optional level gestures, iPhone full-window video/Live TV orientation versus iPad system rotation, and TV transitions. Top Shelf's adult Everyone entry controls local shared visibility, Posters/Full Screen, 1-20 counts defaulting to four, and native swipe-up/Play/More Info; saved source-scoped snapshots retain access and spoiler limits, not live browsing or guaranteed output from format badges. Trace the OS Guide activity into enabled Live TV/full-screen guide, and music background audio into screensaver/Now Playing commands. Distinguish live seeking/Go Live from library-channel Jump to now without promising recordings. Scope wireless subtitle loss to remuxed AirPlay and exclude Multiview. External app handoff differs from AirPlay/PiP and in-app native playback: Native Player is Apple TV-only; Infuse/VLC are offered on both platforms with direct-video and authorized-return limits.

FeatureDiscovery.summary: Use LAN discovery or manual entry; Tailscale is an externally configured connection requiring the server's IP/MagicDNS address, not a Plozz-managed VPN or discoverable LAN server.

FeatureHome.summary: Keep browsing, collection checks/recovery, server/version selection, Watchlists and schedule-only upcoming placeholders together. Explicit No streams found actions recheck source inventory without starting playback; incomplete library/Continue Watching rows retain Details/Try Again recovery. Document the wired tvOS name-sort letter rail. LibraryAlphabetMenu has no construction call in either library screen or elsewhere in the snapshot, and mobile only observes alphabet state; do not advertise a mobile A-Z menu from the helper or README alone.

FeatureLiveTV.summary: Cover reachable channel menus, previews, Multiviews, guide search/correction, source-scoped channel-identity review, local Kids playlist approvals and channel checks. Guide options reaches Review channel identities; confirmed historical identity is applied by the durable cache/import model and reuses saved preferences only when the old entry is absent. The playlist detail's SettingsPageLink reaches scanning; its global Sources destination is nested under library-channel management and unreliable. Source-copy import exists for legacy/fallback flows and syncs differently from current IPTV-account file imports; do not invent a universal alternate import procedure. Personal channel-label/preferences and the separate unavailable-favorite recovery helper have no prototype presentation route, so omit them as unusable controls without confusing them with the reachable identity review.

FeatureMusic.summary: Cover Apple TV server-library listening, queue controls, lyrics and Last.fm in the music guide, including screensaver/background listening and the wired Control Center Now Playing transport session.

FeaturePlayback.summary: Use task sections for player preferences, dual-text-track eligibility, confirmed system-caption-style replacement and live rewind/Go Live. Audio-delay and engine-local Dialog Enhance scaffolding is capability-gated, but neither wired engine advertises it. Separately, the reachable tvOS system-audio bridge supports output-gated Reduce Loud Sounds and Enhance Dialogue/levels for VOD and Live TV; explain global scope, uncertain per-route processing and failure recovery. Experimental FEL is a default-off profile preference for new eligible on-demand sessions with stated resource costs, not a generic upstream compatibility promise. Subtitle overlay timing is independently supported where exposed, while native second tracks require fetchable text delivery and image primaries exclude dual mode. Cover the Cast panel's biography/credits and deliberate page-navigation handoff, which ends playback rather than playing a credit or keeping the current video open.

FeatureProfiles.summary: Cover profile setup, entry/edit authorization, Kids restrictions and device-local automatic sign-in. The Forgot PIN strings in ProfileLockCopy have no presentation call site; both the shared entry PIN screen and management actions lack a reset control. Do not promise recovery from unused labels; another device must already have unlocked editing access before removing a synced lock.

FeatureSettings.summary: Group settings by task with platform/provider limits. Home editing/Next Up stay in Home/navigation; three Continue Watching artwork modes, independent Playback details/Labels and label-preset replacement belong in spoiler/appearance sections, not pages per toggle. External player needs a focused task because device-wide selection, token sharing, direct-source eligibility and progress callbacks have distinct consequences. FEL tradeoffs belong in streaming quality, device-only Top Shelf layout/counts in platform controls, and encoded sync-data sizes in sync troubleshooting. Low-risk sort and Recently watched choices remain within existing tasks.

FeatureSyncCloud.summary: Separate settings/profile/media/tracker channels from mobile Keychain adoption. Live TV source secrets/imported source chunks are encrypted; sync cannot grant local parental approval or materialize an account-imported M3U on another device. Explain on-demand local payload/count snapshots and their exclusions without representing them as CloudKit storage usage. Keep destructive reset/erase warnings and schedule catalogue requirements.

FeatureSyncSetup.summary: Explain reachable receiver/sender setup, local network and scan permissions, code/QR alternatives, conditional verification and provider transfer limits. Same-account rendezvous and scanned QR pin the recipient key; ordinary links do not silently bypass verification.

MediaDownloads.summary: Explain network/speed limits, provider copies and offline validation. Background HTTP sessions differ from in-process share work; continued processing/Live Activities remain an OS decision, and all bytes received is not a validated completed copy. Distinguish pause/resume from destructive bulk cancellation of unfinished copies and profile-scoped deletion of all saved downloads.

MediaTransportCore.omitReason: Internal file-system capability and bounded-read contracts expose no independent reader setting or procedure. Protocol selection, authentication, scanning and download limits are documented under connections and offline viewing instead.

MediaTransportFTP.summary: Cover FTP and manually addressed implicit FTPS in the share task; composition does not produce explicit AUTH TLS connections.

MediaTransportHTTP.omitReason: Shared HTTP range validation, sessions and trust plumbing support WebDAV and media reads, not a separately selectable HTTP library type. Documenting this implementation as another source would misrepresent the add-share UI.

MediaTransportNFS.summary: State the wired NFSv3 requirement and export-based access rules in the network-share procedure, not a separate protocol guide.

MetadataKit.summary: Keep provider ordering/cache controls in metadata, lyric availability in music and community skips in playback. Home explains selecting public Discovery catalogues independently of Seerr requests, with Kids restrictions and no implied playable ownership. This is recommendation discovery, not the FeatureDiscovery module's LAN server search. Marker requests include applicable title/episode metadata and runtime, not video uploads; server markers and third-party coverage remain distinct.

ProviderIPTV.summary: Keep playlist/Xtream and EPG setup, scoped guide credentials, local account-file imports, guide-only operation and optional on-demand catalogues in existing source/library tasks. HTTP/proxy/parsing diagnostics do not add a new selectable source type.

ProviderShare.summary: Cover share connection/scanning and movie/TV local NFO/artwork association in existing guides. Personal Videos deliberately bypasses catalogue matching. Local metadata precedence and ambiguous-folder rejection are implemented in scanner/enrichment/projection, not inferred from NFO filenames alone.

TopShelfKit.summary: Document Apple TV placement, local shared visibility/layout/count preferences, same-copy deduplication, Play versus More Info and current access checks. Full-screen metadata uses known source facts, series artwork and spoiler policy, never a guarantee of output or a live server browser. Poster/backdrop composition is infrastructure, not another reader control.

TraktService.summary: Separate Watchlist sync, completed watches and partial pause progress returned by supported external players. Mark as Unwatched does not delete Trakt history. Shared sign-in recovery belongs in trackers; receipt/debug response plumbing needs no separate user procedure.

WetrakrService.summary: Production-enabled but configuration-gated video tracking and planning-list read/write integration is reachable on both platforms. Cover authorization and connection recovery in trackers and list propagation in library. View on WeTrakr, when present for imported entries, is an external link/TV QR handoff rather than media playback; this self-explanatory link needs no standalone guide.

appearance.summary: Keep theme/card/artwork controls together; retain focused spoiler and Circadian tasks because their visibility and scheduling consequences need explanation.

language.summary: Use the appearance guide to explain System language selection and distinguish interface language from audio, subtitles, server-supplied metadata and device-region date/number formatting rather than a separate picker guide. System-drawn player controls and permission prompts keep the device language.

libraries.summary: Explain shared sign-ins versus profile-enabled libraries and server-user permissions, with music visibility in its platform-specific task.

liveTV.summary: Keep guide previews, favorites/hidden channels, search and mobile cellular policy in the Live TV reference. Explain local whole-source Kids approval and source-configuration sync separately; straightforward ordering/filter choices need no individual pages.

playback.summary: Cover version mode/series memory, autoplay/skips, quality, audio, background listening, orientation/gestures and history with platform/provider gates. Missing remembered versions fall back automatically in automatic mode. Advanced > External player is device-wide rather than profile-owned; its focused guide explains platform apps, custom templates, direct-play fallback, access-token sharing and authorized progress returns. Advanced > Dolby Vision FEL is separately profile-scoped and default-off; document eligibility, new-session behavior and resource costs in streaming quality.

screensNavigation.summary: Group Home section add/remove/reorder and preset replacement, default Next Up merging, the pinned Apple TV Home layout/mobile Hero entry, Discovery catalogue selection and Seerr/Kids limits, details, navigation and exit behavior. Continue Watching independently chooses Artwork + logo/Thumbnail/Poster, Detailed/Progress only and Follow Appearance/On/Off labels. Library availability is separate; link music eligibility rather than implying every platform has that tab.

subtitles.summary: Combine language codes/device fallback, per-content policies, SDH/search, remembered series choices and text/image styling limits rather than separate pages per preference. Explain Prefer SDH fallback versus strict Only SDH automatic/search/download selection, matching device caption appearance, replacement confirmation and leaving matching through custom edits.

trackers.summary: Use the trackers task for profile sign-ins, media eligibility, list/history behavior, configured WeTrakr availability, Retry/Reconnect and failed revocation recovery; retain Apple TV-only Last.fm and separate cross-server history/iCloud sync.
